* LLM review says a session that resumed is reused after the engine started closing it.
* Could we check `sess->closing` before the reuse, so a closing session is never handed back?
* Add a test to `test/engine_test.c`: drop the link mid-resume, expect no reuse of the old session.

Cause: introduced
Found: traced, by reading the code. Nothing was run.
Raised by: c-systems-reviewer
Exposure: who: every client that reconnects. Likely: on any network drop. Opt-in: no.
Impact: a reconnect reuses a closing session
